sshServer._option1: Simple format - just use a host from ~/.ssh/config:

portRange._comment: Port range for SOCKS5 proxy allocation

_httpProxyPort_comment: Port for the HTTP proxy server
_inactivityTimeout_comment: Seconds of no data before restarting (default: 60)
_retryAttempts_comment: Number of restart attempts before giving up (default: 3)
_logLevel_comment: Log level: debug, info, warn, error (default: info)
